atoms.text: Rhys now wants to take you around Cardiff to end the tour. Will you go around Cardiff with him?

instruction.text: Select Cardiff on the map to return there.
Rhys wants to know if you recognise Cardiff’s famous landmarks. Select the correct image.

hint.text: A landmark is a building or place that is easily recognisable. For example, it could be a huge tower, a statue or a mountain.
hint.label: Landmark

wrong.text: This is the Brandenburg Gate in Berlin, Germany.

feedback.correct: The Wales Millennium Centre is a national arts centre, where you can watch theatre shows, operas, dances and more!

feedback.wrong: This is the Acropolis of Athens in Greece.
feedback.correct: Cardiff Castle was built on the site of an old Roman fort by Norman invaders in the 11th century. It’s been through a lot of history but still stands strong today!

feedback.wrong: This is Christ the Redeemer in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
feedback.correct: The Pierhead Building is a historic building on the docks of Cardiff Bay. It currently acts as a venue for all kinds of events and meetings.

atoms.a: “Just under a million people can speak Welsh. Do you know what Cardiff is called in Welsh?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m1GbWls'>Just under a million people can speak Welsh. Do you know what Cardiff is called in Welsh?</voice>

atoms.a: “Cardiff is by the coast. What activities do you think we could do here?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m1GbWls'>Cardiff is by the coast. What activities do you think we could do here?</voice>

feedback.end: Cardiff doesn’t have its own beach, but there are beaches that are close by!
